crossRefs.note: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around…
You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

parallels.note: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

translations.web: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.
translations.bsb: Overlay with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns, and make a molding of gold around it.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
translations.asv: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
